subject: MAP: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery (post-call recap)

Hi Samuel —1 great to speak today. Thanks again for walking through Aurelia Tech's requirements and timelines. Per our discovery call, I captured the key items below and attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review / SOC 2 package milestone. Please see the MAP draft attached (MAP-draft-v1.docx) and the SOC 2 questionnaire we referenced.

Quick recap & asks from our side:
- Objective: get SOC 2 package evidence and complete your security review so you can approve a production pilot by 2026-08-21 (target close).
- Key dependencies: your security team review, Redwood SOC 2 evidence delivery, Azure tenancy/network whitelist, and SE review for integration.
- Attached: SOC2-questionnaire.pdf, evidence-list.xlsx, MAP-draft-v1.docx (draft milestones + owners).

Proposed MAP milestone for security review:
- Deliverable: SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence bundle (we'll provide a mapping to controls).
- Owner: Redwood (Marissa + Operations) to deliver questionnaire responses and evidence; Aurelia Tech Security (Samuel + security@aurelia-tech.com) to review and sign off.
- Target dates: Redwood to submit evidence by 2026-07-28; Aurelia review complete by 2026-08-07; pilot approval 2026-08-21.

Next steps (can you confirm):
1) Samuel —1 confirm that 2026-08-21 works for pilot approval (or propose new target).
2) Security team —1 confirm preferred format for evidence (PDFs, SCIM logs, or shared Drive folder).
3) Dev/SE alignment —1 Dev, I copied you for integration/whitelisting follow-up.

Thanks —1 I'll update the MAP doc with any changes once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0147

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire.pdf (attachment); evidence-list.xlsx (attachment); MAP-draft-v1.docx (attachment)

From: Samuel Park <samuel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery (post-call recap)

Marissa —1 thanks for the thorough recap and MAP. Confirming receipt of the attachments. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Target close: 2026-08-21 is fine as a working target; our security lead will confirm exact calendar availability.
- Evidence format: Security prefers a shared Drive folder with PDFs and a narrow index spreadsheet —1 the evidence-list.xlsx looks fine. Please avoid sending large log dumps; pointers to retained logs are better.
- Questionnaire: we'll start with the SOC2-questionnaire.pdf and will push technical questions to our security alias.

I'll loop our security lead (security@aurelia-tech.com) to coordinate. Expect their note with availability for an evidence-review call.

Thanks,
Sam
Director, IT Risk & Security
Aurelia Tech
samuel.park@aurelia-tech.com

From: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 10:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa —1 this is Hannah (Aurelia Tech Security). Quick alignment:

- Preferred evidence delivery: shared Drive + index spreadsheet (PDFs). Please include a mapping to SOC 2 common criteria IDs if possible.
- Questionnaire: we'll review the attached SOC2-questionnaire.pdf and add comments in Google Drive.
- Call availability: we're available for a short evidence-review call on 2026-07-29 or 2026-07-30 (morning ET). Please propose times.

Outstanding ask for Redwood: please confirm which system artifacts you will include (examples below) and provide expected file names in the evidence-list.xlsx:
  - SOC 2 report (redacted) —1 Redwood_SOC2_report_redacted.pdf
  - Access control policy —1 access-control.pdf
  - Change management logs —1 change-mgmt-logs.csv (or pointer)
  - Network architecture diagram —1 network-arch.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah Li
Security Manager
Aurelia Tech
security@aurelia-tech.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samuel Park <samuel.park@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery (post-call recap)

Thanks Hannah —1 quick technical note on the artifacts and dependencies from Redwood's side:

- Change management logs: we can provide export of ticket metadata (CSV) and a pointer to internal Jira ticket IDs —1 we will not export full ticket bodies. File: change-mgmt-logs.csv
- Network diagram: we will provide a high-level network-arch.pdf showing VPC/subnet and ingress controls.
- Access control: we will include access-control.pdf and an IAM role mapping (redwood-iam-mapping.csv) as an index in the evidence spreadsheet.
- For log retention pointers: we can provide retention policy docs and a syslog pointer with timestamps; if you need raw logs we'll discuss narrow scoping.

Regarding the evidence-review call, Marissa —1 we can make 2026-07-29 at 10:30am ET work on our side. I'll be available to answer SE questions and confirm whitelist steps for the pilot.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: evidence-list.xlsx (contains filenames and short descriptions)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@aurelia-tech.com>, Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery (post-call recap)

Hi all —1 Rishi here (RevOps/Sales Ops). Appreciate the fast turnaround. Two quick administrative items to keep MAP momentum: 

1) I've updated the MAP draft with milestone owners and due dates per email thread and put it in the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=MAP-draft-v1). Please review the "Security Review" section —1 current dates: Redwood submits evidence by 2026-07-28; Aurelia review by 2026-08-07; pilot approval 2026-08-21.
2) Contract/Procurement: once security signs off, we'll share a final SOW and put the deal into signature. I added a conditional milestone for DocuSign routing.

Action items:
- Marissa: upload the finalized evidence bundle to the shared Drive by 2026-07-28 EOD.
- Hannah/Security: confirm the review slot (2026-07-29 10:30am ET proposed) or propose alternate.
- Dev: confirm the exact whitelist IPs and any required Azure tenant info during the call.

Samuel/Hannah —1 let me know if any of these dates need to shift; happy to adjust the MAP.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
RevOps
Redwood Inference
